Marco: Heads-up: perf regression on staging after 4f9a3b3. nsys shows extra memcpy spikes during kernel selection for long-context workloads. Can folks take a look?
Anya: Saw it. Putting perfetto capture here: https://perfetto.example/trace/abc123 :eyes:
Diane: I ran an nsys capture locally. Timeline shows repeated kernel_select entries while KV cache miss handling loops. Snippet: ```GPU memcpy  1.2ms
kernel_select 0.9ms
kv_prefetch 0.8ms
GPU memcpy  1.1ms```
Kyle: Is this the batching heuristic change from #332? It introduced the 2ms coalesce delay.
Marco: Yes — that delay seems to cause repeated cold kernel-choice probing for long seqs (>=2048). We need better trace instrumentation: NVTX ranges for per-request lifecycle and explicit ranges around kernel selection + kv prefetch/apply so we can correlate host->gpu behavior.
Zara: I can prototype NVTX naming: `rt.req/<req_id>/start`, `rt.req/<req_id>/kernel_select`, `rt.req/<req_id>/kv_prefetch`, `rt.req/<req_id>/kv_apply`. Keep names short and include a small payload int for version. Thoughts? :+1:
Anya: Prefer consistent separator — we use dots elsewhere (rt.req) but slashes are fine for readability. Most important: keep name length < 64.
Diane: Note: NVTX on some drivers doesn't carry full strings reliably. For cross-driver stability let's put a version int in the NVTX payload and dump richer JSON to the host log as `trace_meta` events. Then perfetto can join by req_id.
Kyle: Also add tiny ranges for `kv:hit` / `kv:miss` around get/put ops. That will make it obvious whether we're spinning on misses vs cache apply latency.
Marco: Action items: Zara to PR NVTX helper (C++ API) with canonical naming template + payload version. Diane/Kyle to rerun nsys captures with `--capture-range=nvtx` after PR lands. I'll roll back the coalesce heuristic in staging until we confirm root cause.
Zara: On it. Will follow `rt.*` prefix and keep names <=64 chars. PR will include unit tests toggling NVTX at runtime.
Diane: I'll attach a perfetto diff and a few screenshots after I re-run with NVTX ranges. Early observation: kernel_select spikes when seq_len > 2048 and batch_size < 4.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: rollback staging from 4f9a3b3 -> 3cc2b1a deployed by Marco at 2026-03-18T17:05:30Z :white_check_mark:
Marco: Thanks. Once Zara's PR is up let's land it behind a flag and re-run a couple of representative workloads (chat long-turn, batched embeddings). Short traces only — keep captures 30s max.
